controls.label: Audio Reactivity65%Strength of bounded bass, energy, vocal and rhythmic reactions. Zero restores the authored native motion. Pattern Change and BPM Sync remain independent.
BPM SyncLocks native motion to shared tempo. Off runs at the 120 BPM reference; the host toggle does not override this choice.

Auto PerformanceThe shared Mood Conductor directs bounded motion and effects, pattern timing and temporary build/drop programs. Turn off to edit Design and Effects; saved values and palette are preserved.
Geometry MotionOff shows the selected pattern at rest. No sphere, particle or bar movement continues. Camera and Logo Motion have their own controls.
Geometry Extent35%Deformation strength in the native variants. Reference Vortex keeps the original sphere shape and animates its rotation.
Logo MotionIndependent rotation and sway of the complete original 3D logo. Off holds its manual orientation.
Camera Speed1.00Speed of automatic camera travel. Zero holds its current position; independent of geometry and logo motion.
